name: mixed-language-1
description: North-Indian sweet shop card, single side, OCR'd with hin+eng so Devanagari comes through as real script. Top: small Devanagari invocation ('॥ श्री गणेशाय नमः ॥' read as '|| ... ||'), then the BIGGEST line is the Devanagari brand 'शर्मा मिष्ठान भंडार' (h38) with the English transliteration 'Sharma Mishthan Bhandar' smaller (h24, Title Case, no legal/industry keyword — reads like a 3-word person name), a Devanagari-only tagline, then the person 'Rakesh Kumar Sharma' + 'Proprietor', Hindi phone labels ('मो.' for mobile with two comma-separated numbers, 'दूरभाष' = telephone for the STD landline), an E-mail line with an OCR space before '@', two English address lines with 'City - PIN (State)' pattern, and GSTIN. Stresses: non-Latin brand line vs Latin company name (fallback picks the biggest line regardless of script), Devanagari phone labels (classification must fall back to number shape), Title-Case company line competing with the real name.
